'''False signal generators''' were countermeasures used to disguise the true nature of a [[Cluster bomb/Legends|cluster bomb]]. The unit generated emissions that mimicked the readings given off by an active [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]].<ref name="EGWT" />
